subject: fieldMask could be used to "cut" two images?

messages.author: 0b90a2764fdb150d
messages.subject: fieldMask could be used to "cut" two images?
parts:
Dear All
probably i've not completely understood the grammar of fieldMask, but what i'm porsuing is what detailed in:
https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P13
paragraph # Removing the soil using index and mask from step 4:
third code line EX3.RemSoil<-fieldMask(EX3.RS$newMosaic,mask = EX2.RemSoil$mask ,cropValue=0,cropAbove=T,plot=T) # Removing weeds from senescence stage with flowering mask 

I have a bunch of radiometric images like the attached one flir_20210104T131612.jpg 
Using exiftool i've extracted corripondent image in visible range flir_20210104T131612_fullVIS.jpg
Both images are 1440x1080 with same resolution 72by72

EX1<-stack("D:/Thermo/flir_20210104T131612_fullVIS.jpg")
EX2<-stack("D:/Thermo/flir_20210104T131612.jpg")

EX1.RemSoil<-fieldMask(mosaic = EX1, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, index = "BGI", cropValue = 1.1, cropAbove = T)                #removing background in visible image

Now i have only plants without background (dead fallen leaves and soil). Now i want to "cut" the radiometric images, EX2, using EX1.RemSoil in order to compare the average temperature of plants within different herbicide treatments

fieldMask(EX2,mask = EX1.RemSoil ,cropValue=0,cropAbove=T,plot=T)

I received an error "Mask must have only one band"
Any hints of what i'm missing??

Regards

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: fieldMask could be used to "cut" two images?
parts:
Hi there,

Thank you for asking.
"fieldMask" returns 2 objects (i) EX1.RemSoil$mask and (ii) EX1.RemSoil$newMosaic. 
You need to specify $mask. Try to use the following code:

fieldMask(EX2, mask = EX1.RemSoil$mask)

Let me know if it worked,
Filipe

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: fieldMask could be used to "cut" two images?
parts:
Hi there,
I change the function fieldMask and upgrade the package to version 0.2.6. 
Please try to upgrade the version and follow the code below:

devtools::install_github("filipematias23/FIELDimageR") #0.2.6
library(FIELDimageR)
library(raster)
EX1<-stack("flir_20210104T131612_fullVIS.jpg")
EX2<-stack("flir_20210104T131612.jpg")

EX1.RemSoil<-fieldMask(mosaic = EX1, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, 
                       index = "BGI", cropValue = 1.1, cropAbove = T)                #removing background in visible image

EX1.RemSoil<-fieldMask(mosaic = EX2,mask = EX1.RemSoil$mask, projection = F)

All the best,
Filipe
